title: Apharwat Peak in Gulmarg: Explore Kashmir’s Highest Snow Point & Gondola Experience
content:
Apharwat Peak in Gulmarg

Apharwat Peak is one of the most beautiful and thrilling places to visit in Gulmarg, Kashmir. Known for its snow-covered mountains, breathtaking views, and adventure activities, Apharwat Peak attracts tourists from all over India and the world. Located close to the Line of Control (LOC), this high-altitude destination offers a raw and untouched beauty that feels truly magical.Apharwat Peak is not just a place you visit-it’s a feeling you carry back with you. Located high above Gulmarg, this snow-covered mountain shows you the raw, untouched side of Kashmir. The air feels thinner, the silence feels deeper, and the views feel endless.

Where Is Apharwat Peak Located?

Apharwat Peak is situated around 13 km from Gulmarg in the Baramulla district of Jammu and Kashmir. Standing at nearly 4,200 meters above sea level, it lies close to the Line of Control (LOC). Because of its location and altitude, the area feels wild, peaceful, and far away from city life.

How to Reach Apharwat Peak

The journey to Apharwat Peak is one of the most exciting parts of the trip. You reach the peak using the famous Gulmarg Gondola, one of the highest cable cars in the world.First, the gondola takes you from Gulmarg to Kongdoori Station. This part feels calm and scenic. From Kongdoori, the second phase of the gondola lifts you higher into a world of snow and clouds. As the trees disappear, you start to see nothing but white slopes and distant Himalayan peaks.

Best Time to Visit Apharwat Peak

Your experience at Apharwat Peak changes with the season.

From December to March, the peak turns into a snow paradise. This is the best time for snow lovers, skiing, and snowboarding. April to June still offers snow at the top with slightly easier weather conditions. During the monsoon months, access is limited and visits are not recommended. October and November are cold and quiet, with early snowfall and fewer tourists.

For most travelers, winter is the most magical time to visit

What to Do at Apharwat Peak

Apharwat Peak is not about rushing from one activity to another. It’s about slowing down and soaking in the moment.

Things you can enjoy here:

  • Experience fresh, untouched snow during winter months
  • Try skiing and snowboarding (best for experienced riders)
  • Enjoy panoramic Himalayan views from the top
  • Click stunning photos of snowfields and mountains
  • Feel the silence and peace of high-altitude landscapes
  • Enjoy the Gulmarg Gondola Phase 2 ride, one of the highest cable cars in the world.

Weather and Temperature

Weather at Apharwat Peak can change quickly. Winters are extremely cold, with temperatures often falling below minus 10 degrees Celsius. Strong winds are common at the top. In summer, the temperature remains cool and pleasant, but warm clothing is still necessary.Because of the high altitude, breathing may feel difficult for some visitors, especially those not used to mountain regions.

Nearest Places to Visit from Apharwat Peak

After visiting Apharwat Peak, you can explore these nearby attractions:

  • Kongdoori: Snow activities and scenic views
  • Gulmarg Golf Course: One of the highest golf courses in the world
  • St. Mary’s Church: A peaceful spot with beautiful surroundings
  • Maharani Temple: Offers panoramic views of Gulmarg
  • Strawberry Valley: A quiet meadow, perfect for short walks

These places are easily accessible from Gulmarg and can be covered on the same day.

Why Apharwat Peak Is Worth Visiting

What makes Apharwat Peak special is its untouched beauty. It feels less commercial and more natural than many tourist spots. The wide snowfields, silent mountains, and fresh air create a sense of peace that is hard to find elsewhere.If you want to see Kashmir beyond gardens and lakes, Apharwat Peak shows you its wild and powerful side.
excerpt: Apharwat Peak in Gulmarg is one of the highest and most scenic snow points in Kashmir. Reached by the famous Gondola cable car, it offers breathtaking views, winter sports, and an unforgettable mountain experience for travelers.
